summaries.zh: DSH plugin: rate every DeepSeek call by token output / cache hit / cost, auto-tune the max_tokens output budget via a sliding rheostat, and auto-sync official pricing with peak/off-peak billing.
summaries.en: DSH plugin: rate every DeepSeek call by token output / cache hit / cost, auto-tune the max_tokens output budget via a sliding rheostat, and auto-sync official pricing with peak/off-peak billing.
